rules.text: Communication: how you react to and communicate with others

source.quote: It relates how an individual reacts and communicates with others.

rules.say: With 1 in your birth date, this number shapes how you communicate and react to others; how many times it appears shows how.

rules.text: Sensitivity and intuition: how sensitive and intuitive you are

source.quote: It relates how sensitive and intuitive an individual is.

rules.say: With 2 in your birth date, this number shapes your sensitivity and intuition; how many times it appears shows how strong they are.

rules.text: Planning and imagination: intellectual capacity, memory, clear and logical thinking

source.quote: It relates the intellectual capacity of an individual, and the memory and ability to think clearly and logically.

rules.say: With 3 in your birth date, you have planning and imagination, with intellectual capacity, a good memory and the ability to think clearly and logically.

rules.text: Discipline and organisation: neat, tidy, good with details, practical and hard-working; order and balance

source.quote: It relates to neat, tidy and good with details.

rules.say: With 4 in your birth date, you are disciplined and organised: neat, tidy, good with details, practical and hard-working, valuing order and balance.

rules.text: Balance (emotional and mental): emotional stability; freedom

source.quote: It relates to balance and emotional stability of an individual. Also relates to freedom.

rules.say: With 5 in your birth date, you have emotional and mental balance and stability, along with a love of freedom.

rules.text: Home and family: creativity, love of home and family, helpful, friendly; very insecure about home and family, especially children

source.quote: These individuals are very insecure for their home and family particularly for their children.

rules.say: You are creative, helpful and friendly, with a deep love for home and family. You can feel very insecure about your home and family, especially your children.

rules.text: Disappointments: sacrifice; heart rules the head; learns through losses or disappointments in love, emotions, health and finance

source.quote: Their heart rules over head. They learn through there losses or disappointments of four kinds

rules.say: With 7 in your birth date, your heart rules your head, and you may learn through sacrifice and through losses or disappointments in love, emotions, health and finance.

rules.text: Discipline and organisation: attention to detail

source.quote: It is associated with discipline & organized. It relates to attention to detail.

rules.say: With 8 in your birth date, you are disciplined and organised, with attention to detail.

source.quote: It relates to idealism, valor, and ambition.

rules.say: You carry a humanitarian spirit, with idealism, courage and ambition.
